propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced CLI parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stdlib argparse.HelpFormatter instead of version-pinned RebarHelpFormatter, creating width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and py3.13 staleness risk in committed help artifacts.

py3.13 argparse divergences in short+long option metavar rendering and subparser usage wrapping cause gen_cli_help.py --check to silently stale on py3.13 only for the four non-bridge factories, replicating the S2d failure mode.
Help-backed route factory formatters must uniformly subclass RebarHelpFormatter to guarantee cross-version deterministic help rendering and prevent latent regression traps.

Intercept-group advanced parsers (verify.py, reconcile, config, identity, enrich, certs, workflow, jira) are out of scope because gen_cli_help.py never renders them and gen_cli_reference.py already canonicalizes their live --help cross-version at the doc layer.
